ms.report:
Data Source and Consistency
Origin of Data for the Charts
The data for the analytics charts is sourced directly from the Cardano blockchain. We utilise:
・Ouroboros-network-js, an open-source library, to access and process blockchain data efficiently.
・Proprietary code integrated within Cardanoscan to further refine, aggregate, and visualise the data for real-time accuracy and reliability.

Data consistency in Charts
・Daily Data Charts: Data is updated daily, displaying metrics up to the previous UTC day. Locale time differences might create the impression of a delay, but the displayed data reflects the most recent complete UTC day.
・Epoch Reward Distribution Chart: This chart has a two-epoch delay due to the inherent protocol design and how rewards are finalised within the Cardano blockchain.
・Hourly Average Block Size Chart: This chart provides data up to the last UTC hour, ensuring timely insights while maintaining data consistency.

Charts Deployed on Mainnet As part of this proposal,

・All Charts List Page - https://cardanoscan.io/analytics
・Epoch Reward Distribution Chart - https://cardanoscan.io/analytics/epochRewardDistribution
・Daily Tx Count and Fees Chart - https://cardanoscan.io/analytics/dailyTxCountAndFees
・Fee collection per Epoch Chart - https://cardanoscan.io/analytics/epochFees
・Absolute Transaction Count Chart - https://cardanoscan.io/analytics/absoluteTxCount
・Block Size Trend Chart - https://cardanoscan.io/analytics/blockSize
